officialText:
Section 408.10 – Add a new Section 408.10 to Part I to read as follows:

408.10 Listing Requirements. Switchboards, Switchgear, and Panelboards shall be listed.

Informational Note: For further information on listing standards, see UL 891 for Switchboards, UL 1558 for Switchgear, and UL 67 for Panelboards.
